title: Why √2 Is Not a Fraction
body: <svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 800"><style>.title{font-family:serif;font-size:50px;fill:#d4af37;text-anchor:middle;font-weight:bold}.text{font-family:serif;font-size:32px;fill:white;text-anchor:middle}.small{font-family:serif;font-size:26px;fill:#60a5fa;text-anchor:middle}.line{stroke:#d4af37;stroke-width:4}.guide{stroke:#60a5fa;stroke-width:3;stroke-dasharray:8 8}</style><rect x="60" y="50" width="1080" height="700" rx="40" fill="#101827" fill-opacity=".85" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="3"/><text x="600" y="120" class="title">Why √2 Is Not a Fraction</text><rect x="150" y="220" width="220" height="220" fill="#162943" stroke="#d4af37" stroke-width="4"/><line x1="150" y1="440" x2="370" y2="220" stroke="#60a5fa" stroke-width="6"/><text x="260" y="500" class="text">Diagonal = √2</text><text x="260" y="550" class="small">A real length</text><text x="760" y="220" class="text">Fraction attempts</text><line x1="600" y1="300" x2="1050" y2="300" class="line"/><line x1="740" y1="270" x2="740" y2="330" class="line"/><line x1="800" y1="270" x2="800" y2="330" class="line"/><line x1="850" y1="270" x2="850" y2="330" class="line"/><line x1="900" y1="270" x2="900" y2="330" class="line"/><text x="740" y="370" class="small">1.4</text><text x="800" y="430" class="small">1.41</text><text x="850" y="490" class="small">1.414</text><line x1="850" y1="300" x2="850" y2="560" class="guide"/><circle cx="850" cy="300" r="10" fill="#d4af37"/><text x="850" y="600" class="text">√2 ≈ 1.414213...</text><text x="600" y="690" class="text">Fractions get closer, but never exactly reach √2</text></svg>
